stem:
Meera collects four pure substances in her school science lab in Jaipur. She checks what kind of particles each substance is made of.

Which substance should she classify as an element?

options.text: distilled water, made of identical molecules each containing hydrogen and oxygen atoms
oxygen gas from a cylinder, made of identical molecules each containing only oxygen atoms
salt solution prepared by dissolving salt in water
sugar crystals, made of molecules containing carbon, hydrogen and oxygen atoms

teacher.key_rationale: An element is a pure substance made of only one kind of identical particle. Oxygen gas consists of identical molecules, each containing only oxygen atoms, so it is an element. Distilled water and sugar are compounds (their molecules contain more than one kind of atom), and salt solution is a mixture, not a pure substance.
